notes.title: NEW RACE MODE + DAMAGE + MOAR
notes.content:
Greetings!
A Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays to all and if I don't see you, a Happy New Year! Today's update is a BIG one! I've been listening to player feedback and here are some of the results.

NEW RACE MODE: ELIMINATION
The new Elimination Race is a true to-the-death, winner-takes-all competition! The number of Laps is locked into the number of Racers (that is, 4, 8, 12 or 16 laps!). Every time the truck in first place laps, the truck in last place is targeted for Elimination! The last truck standing takes 100 percent of the purse! Normal eliminations are disabled in Elimination Mode.

DAMAGE!
As if there wasn't enough savagery, now you can enable Truck Damage! That's right, while you race for your life you can receive or inflict damage with your fellow racers. Damage WILL mess around with your vehicle's handling capabilities. You've been warned! You can toggle Damage on the Player Menu.

RACE CUSTOMIZATION
Race Type - Toggle between Normal races or Elimination races. In Elimination Mode, normal Eliminations are disabled and the number of Laps is locked to the number of Racers.
Eliminations - Toggle Eliminations in Normal races.
Damage - Toggle truck damage in Normal or Elimination races.
Turbos - Toggle Turbo usage in Normal or Elimination races.

MISC
Added a Traffic Light to the beginning of races for that extra visual cue.
Added four achievements for Elimination Mode.
Fixed UI mouse click buys multiple turbos.
Fixed UI mouse click on lower paint colors.
Fixed waypoint issue on Crossfire.

And more on the way. Thanks again for your feedback and support,
Vinny

notes.title: Moar Cheeves Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys!
I just finished adding Moar Cheeves! There are now 32 additional achievements - one for Winning and one for earning Best Lap on each track! Plus two more tracking the completion of those. Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE: Saves and Settings
notes.content:
Hey folks!
Got an update here with Save Files implemented. It's a pretty simple system, best I could do for now. When you start a game you set the Active Save File. That's it!

I also put a Clear Settings button on the Options Menu. So now, if you change things in the Configuration Launcher they will persist between plays. If you mess something up in the Launcher and you want to reset it, just click this button.
Thanks!
Vinny
